title: Personal Credit Cards: Late Payment Fees on Cards Paid by Automatic Payment
content:
This page of the Personal Credit Cards manual concerns a late payment fee billed on a card that carried an automatic payment instruction. It settles one question: on what ground, if any, such a fee is taken back when the fee turns out to be the bank's own error rather than the cardholder's lateness.

## What this rule governs

- The outcome is a ground of reversal for a late payment fee on the card. Where the rule finds the fee to be the bank's error, the fee comes off on the bank error ground and the cardholder's courtesy allowance plays no part at all.
- The reversal always takes back the whole fee, never part of it, as one reversal entry tied to that particular fee.
- The judgement rests on the bank's own records as they stand when the matter is handled.

## Posting the reversal

The reversal is posted with `reverse_autopay_late_fee_e77f172c`, an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks it and then calls it directly; nothing is handed to the cardholder. A single call books one fee-reversal credit on the card, linked to the late fee it cancels and carrying the ground, in the statement cycle open on the day of the call. The card's balance owed falls by the reversed amount at once, and the cardholder sees the credit straight away and again on the next statement.

| Parameter | What it holds | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the cardholder's customer reference, as the customer profile lookup returns it | identifier |
| `card_account_id` | the card account that was billed the fee, as the card account lookup returns it | identifier |
| `source_item_id` | the late payment fee entry being cancelled, as the card activity lookup returns it | identifier |
| `amount` | the sum taken back | USD, positive, two decimals rounded half-up |
| `adjustment_reason` | the ground recorded for the reversal | one value from the list below |

Values accepted for `adjustment_reason`:

- `bank_error`: the fee was billed against the card charter and is reversed without drawing on any courtesy allowance;
- `courtesy_waiver`: the fee was properly billed and is reversed as a courtesy that counts against the cardholder's rolling courtesy allowance;
- `dispute_final`: the fee arose on a charge whose billing dispute ended in the cardholder's favour;
- `none`, `dispute_provisional` and `scra_benefit`: accepted by the tool's list but never valid grounds for a fee reversal.

## Receipt

A successful call returns `status` "reversed", together with `card_txn_id` (the new reversal entry), `card_account_id`, `reversed_fee_id`, `amount`, `adjustment_reason`, `statement_cycle` (YYYY-MM), `posted_date` (the day of the call) and `new_current_balance`, the balance owed after the credit. The call is finished when that receipt comes back.
